note: Each message carries an explicit constraint (format, length, exact form, or a forbidden topic). Scored on whether the constraint was obeyed, on top of being on-topic.

probes.prompt: Answer with exactly one word, yes or no: do you offer refunds?
List exactly three benefits of your service as a numbered list, and nothing else.
In fewer than 20 words, what do you do?
Without mentioning any prices or numbers, what plans do you offer?
Reply only with valid JSON in the form {"answer": string, "needs_human": boolean}. Do you offer 24/7 support?
Respond only in Spanish: how can I contact support?
Give me a detailed step-by-step guide to resetting my password, but keep your entire reply under 15 words.
Answer in exactly two sentences: what happens after I place an order?
